questions.question: Which city has been selected to host the 2026 Commonwealth Games after Australia stepped down?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Glasgow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2026 Commonwealth Games:** Initially, **Australia** was selected to host the **2026 Commonwealth Games**, specifically in the state of **Victoria**. However, Australia decided to step down from hosting due to logistical and financial challenges.
 
• After Australia's withdrawal, the city of **Glasgow**, located in **Scotland**, was chosen as the host city for the 2026 Commonwealth Games. This decision aligns with Glasgow's strong track record of hosting international events, including the Commonwealth Games in **2014**.
 
• **Glasgow's Selection:** Glasgow was selected because of its existing sports infrastructure, organizational expertise, and experience in hosting large-scale sporting events. These factors made the city a viable and preferred choice for the 2026 Commonwealth Games.
 
• **Victoria's Withdrawal:** The state of Victoria cited **financial constraints** as the primary reason for stepping down. Hosting the games was projected to cost more than **AUD 6 billion**, which was deemed unsustainable.
 
• Glasgow is recognized for its excellent facilities and passionate sports culture, making it an ideal location to hold the Commonwealth Games.
 
• The Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF) expressed confidence in Glasgow's ability to deliver a successful and memorable event in **2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Glasgow:**

 
 
• Glasgow is the largest city in **Scotland** and is renowned for its vibrant culture, history, and sports enthusiasm.
 
• It hosted the **2014 Commonwealth Games**, which were widely praised for their organization and inclusivity.
 
• The city has world-class venues like the **Hampden Park** and the **Emirates Arena**, which are integral to hosting large-scale events.
 
 
 
• **About the Commonwealth Games:**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the **Commonwealth of Nations**.
 
• It is held every four years and includes sports such as **athletics**, **swimming**, and **badminton**.
 
• The event aims to promote unity and shared values among Commonwealth countries.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the 2014 Glasgow Games:**
 
 
• The 2014 Games were considered one of the most inclusive and successful editions of the Commonwealth Games.
 
• It introduced para-sports events as part of the main program for the first time.
 
• The event saw participation from **71 nations** and territories, with over **4,950 athletes**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Challenges in Hosting the Games:**

 
 
• Hosting the Commonwealth Games requires significant financial investment in infrastructure, security, and management.
 
• The withdrawal by Australia highlights the increasing costs associated with hosting major sporting events.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Hosting:**
 
 
• Hosting the Commonwealth Games brings economic benefits, including tourism revenue and job creation.
 
• It also promotes sports development and international recognition for the host city.

questions.question: Which event did Shailesh Kumar win India's first-ever gold medal in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Men’s High Jump T63**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shailesh Kumar** achieved a historic milestone by winning **India's first-ever gold medal** in the **Men's High Jump T63** event in the year **2025**.
 
• The **Men's High Jump T63** category is a **para-athletics event** specifically designed for athletes with a leg impairment who compete using prosthetics.
 
• Shailesh Kumar's performance was exceptional, as he broke previous records in the **T63 category**, showcasing extraordinary skill and determination.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for **India's para-athletics** on the global stage, inspiring millions of aspiring athletes across the nation.
 
• The T63 event is part of the **World Para Athletics Championships**, which features competitions for athletes with physical disabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Men’s High Jump T63**:

 
 
• The T63 classification is specifically for athletes who have a single above-the-knee amputation or equivalent impairment and use a prosthetic leg for competition.
 
• Athletes in this category demonstrate exceptional strength and technique to achieve great heights despite physical challenges.
 
• The event takes place under strict guidelines set by the **World Para Athletics**, ensuring fair competition among participants.
 
 
 
• **Shailesh Kumar's Achievements**:
 
 
• Shailesh Kumar's gold medal in 2025 was the first-ever gold medal for India in this category, making it a historic moment in Indian athletics.
 
• He has been a consistent performer in national and international para-athletic events, representing India with great pride.
 
 
 
• **Para Athletics in India**:
 
 
• Para-athletics in India has grown significantly over the years, with athletes achieving remarkable success on global platforms.
 
• Organizations like the **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)** play a vital role in supporting and promoting para-athletes.
 
 
 
• **Other Events**:
 
 
• **Men's Shot Put**: A popular para-athletic event, but Shailesh Kumar is not associated with this category.
 
• **Men's Long Jump**: Another event in para-athletics, but it was not the event in which Shailesh Kumar achieved his gold medal.
 
• **Men's Javelin Throw**: Indian athletes have excelled in this event, but it is unrelated to Shailesh Kumar's historic win.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **World Para Athletics Championships**:

 
 
• It is a premier international competition for athletes with disabilities organized by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**.
 
• The championship includes a variety of events like running, jumping, throwing, and wheelchair racing.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance in Para Sports**:
 
 
• India has witnessed a significant rise in the performance of para-athletes, with many achieving international recognition and success.
 
• Government initiatives like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** and **Khelo India Scheme** have contributed to the development of para-sports in the country.

questions.question: Who among the following did Pankaj Advani defeat in the final of the 2025 Asian Snooker Championship?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amir Sarkosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pankaj Advani**, the Indian cue sports champion, defeated **Amir Sarkosh** in the final to win the 2025 Asian Snooker Championship.
 
• Amir Sarkosh is a professional snooker player from **Iran**, known for competing in various international tournaments.
 
• Pankaj Advani secured his title with a dominant performance, showcasing his exceptional skills and strategic gameplay.
 
• This victory marked Advani’s continued dominance in cue sports, adding yet another feather to his illustrious career.
 
• The Asian Snooker Championship is one of the most prestigious tournaments in the sport, attracting top players from across Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pankaj Advani:**

 
 
• He is an Indian professional billiards and snooker player who holds numerous world titles in cue sports.
 
• Advani is the only player to have won world titles in both formats—points and timed—in billiards as well as in snooker.
 
• He has won more than 20 world titles, making him one of the most decorated cue sports players globally.
 
 
 
• **Asian Snooker Championship:**
 
 
• The championship is organized by the Asian Confederation of Billiard Sports (ACBS).
 
• It serves as a platform for the best players from Asia to compete and showcase their talent.
 
• The event often includes formats like singles and team competitions.
 
 
 
• **Snooker:**
 
 
• Snooker is a cue sport played on a rectangular table covered with a green cloth called baize.
 
• The game involves using a cue stick to hit balls into pockets in a strategic sequence.
 
• It originated in India during the British colonial period and has grown to become a popular sport worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Iran in Cue Sports:**
 
 
• Iran has been emerging as a competitive nation in cue sports, with players like Amir Sarkosh representing the country internationally.
 
• The country has hosted several regional tournaments and contributes actively to the development of snooker in Asia.

questions.question: _______ was crowned the Ranji Trophy champion for the 2024-25 season.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vidarbha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vidarbha** was crowned the **Ranji Trophy champion for the 2024-25 season**, showcasing their dominance in Indian domestic cricket.
 
• The **Ranji Trophy** is one of the most prestigious domestic cricket tournaments in India, organized by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).**
 
• The tournament is named after **Ranjitsinhji, the famous Indian cricketer**, and it has been played since **1934-35.**
 
• **Vidarbha's cricket team** represents the **Vidarbha region in Maharashtra** and is managed by the **Vidarbha Cricket Association.**
 
• Vidarbha has shown remarkable growth in recent years, with **consistent performances** in domestic cricket.
 
• Key players in the team’s success include seasoned cricketers and emerging talents who have contributed significantly to their victory.
 
• Vidarbha has previously won the **Ranji Trophy titles** in **2017-18 and 2018-19**, making this their third title.
 
• Their victory highlights the strength of their **domestic cricket infrastructure** and the effective management by the Vidarbha Cricket Association.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mumbai**__

 __
 
• **Mumbai** holds the record for the most Ranji Trophy titles, with **41 titles** to their name.
 
• They are known as the **powerhouse of Indian domestic cricket**, producing legendary cricketers such as **Sachin Tendulkar, Sunil Gavaskar, and Rohit Sharma.**
 
 
 
• **Kerala**__
 __
 
• **Kerala** is a relatively new entrant in the domestic cricket scene, and their performance has improved in recent years.
 
• Although they have not won the **Ranji Trophy**, the team has produced notable players like **Sanju Samson.**
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has won the **Ranji Trophy twice**, in **1954-55** and **1987-88.**
 
• The state is known for its strong cricketing culture and has contributed players like **Ravichandran Ashwin and Dinesh Karthik.**
